nodes.label: GAIK Toolkit Changelog
nodes.rationale: Tracks all notable changes to gaik-toolkit using SemVer; version is derived from git tags via setuptools_scm.

nodes.label: v0.5.13 CompositeExtractionRequirements Breaking Change
nodes.rationale: Constructor migrated from child_container_name+child_requirements kwargs to children: list[ChildRequirements], enabling a single parent with multiple distinct child collections.

nodes.label: Knowledge Capture Process
nodes.rationale: One of three core knowledge processes in the toolkit: extracting information from business documents, videos, voice recordings, emails, and meeting recordings.

nodes.label: Knowledge Access Process
nodes.rationale: One of three core knowledge processes: intelligent access to organizational knowledge via document repositories, databases, wikis, CRMs.

nodes.label: Knowledge Synthesis Process
nodes.rationale: One of three core knowledge processes: automatic generation of business reports, sales proposals, marketing materials, project proposals.

nodes.label: GAIK Layer-Based Architecture
nodes.rationale: Spans from strategic planning to implementation and security: Strategy, Requirements, Business, Implementation, Security Compliance, and Guidance layers.

nodes.label: Build Software Component Skill
nodes.rationale: Creates a new GAIK software component as an installable Python package; follows a 6-phase workflow: Context Gathering, Plan Creation, Plan Review, Execution, Verification, and optional Full Release.

nodes.label: GAIK Component Conventions Reference
nodes.rationale: Defines directory layout, __init__.py patterns, constructor patterns, result dataclass patterns, and extras naming for all new GAIK software components.

nodes.label: GAIK Component File Templates Reference
nodes.rationale: Provides literal file templates (8 templates) for __init__.py, main class, README, example, pyproject.toml edit, and parent __init__.py edits.

nodes.label: GAIK Component Verification Reference
nodes.rationale: Defines install command, import smoke test, example run, and final status report steps plus common failure modes for new components.

nodes.label: GAIK Add Examples Skill
nodes.rationale: Adds or updates working code examples for GAIK toolkit components and pipelines; offers gated follow-ups: API docs, Fumadocs website, demo app, PyPI release tag.

nodes.label: GAIK Toolkit Overview Skill
nodes.rationale: Reference skill providing overview of GAIK components, config patterns, repo structure, building-block API tables, docs update map, demo app, and docs website setup.

nodes.label: GAIK Demo App Reference
nodes.rationale: Describes the Next.js 16 + FastAPI demo app: tech stack (bun+uv), project structure, demo pages, API routes, environment variables, and deployment to OpenShift/Rahti.

nodes.label: GAIK Documentation Website Reference
nodes.rationale: Fumadocs/Next.js site at guidance_layer/website/; uses pnpm (not bun); deployed to GitHub Pages via pages.yml workflow on push to main.

nodes.label: GAIK RAG Building Blocks API Reference
GitHub Pages Deployment Workflow
nodes.rationale: Deploys Fumadocs docs website to GitHub Pages on push to main (paths: guidance_layer/website/**); uses pnpm 9, Node.js 20, outputs to guidance_layer/website/out.

nodes.label: Publish to PyPI Workflow
nodes.rationale: Triggered on v*.*.* git tags; runs tests, builds wheel+sdist, validates version matches tag, uploads to PyPI, installs from PyPI, creates GitHub Release. Version derived by setuptools-scm from tag.

nodes.label: Run Tests Workflow
nodes.rationale: Runs pytest on push to main/dev and on PRs; matrix Python 3.11+3.12 for push, 3.11-only for PRs; uses uv; installs gaik[all,dev].

nodes.label: Business Layer README
nodes.rationale: Business layer supports GenAI solution design: use case definition (GenAI product canvas), workflow analysis (extended BPMN), and work system analysis and redesign.

nodes.label: GenAI Product Canvas
nodes.rationale: Template (PPTX) helping teams structure the GenAI problem, clarify expected value, identify users/stakeholders, and define how GenAI will be used in practice.

nodes.label: VisionExtractor
nodes.rationale: Single-pass PDF/image to structured data via vision LLM; supports OpenAI, Claude, Google; include_verification wraps fields in VerifiableField with confidence_score and reasoning.

nodes.label: ParallelTranscriber
nodes.rationale: Production-grade parallel transcription using FFmpeg chunking; requires ffmpeg+ffprobe on PATH; supports TranscriptionModel.WHISPER and GPT4O_DIARIZE.

nodes.label: LLMJudge
nodes.rationale: Validates extracted data using rubric scoring (Likert 1-5), hallucination detection, and text-pair equivalence; supports multiple providers.

nodes.label: PgVectorStore
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL+pgvector store supporting semantic, keyword, and hybrid search (RRF); requires pgvector, pg_trgm, unaccent extensions.

nodes.label: FinnishTextProcessor
nodes.rationale: Finnish lemmatization + compound splitting for hybrid search; backends: voikko (best, requires libvoikko), spacy, uralic, simple fallback.

nodes.label: ExtractionEvaluator
nodes.rationale: Field-level Precision/Recall/F1 + hallucination rate; supports exact and semantic (LLMJudge Likert) match modes; micro-averaged.

nodes.label: RAGEvaluator
nodes.rationale: RAGAS-style metrics (faithfulness, answer_relevance, context_precision, context_recall) via LLMJudge; Likert 1-5 aggregated to 0-1.

nodes.label: AudioToStructuredData Pipeline
nodes.rationale: End-to-end pipeline: Audio -> Transcriber -> SchemaGenerator -> DataExtractor -> Structured JSON.

nodes.label: DocumentsToStructuredData Pipeline
nodes.rationale: End-to-end pipeline: PDF/DOCX -> Parser -> SchemaGenerator -> DataExtractor -> Structured JSON. Supports vision_parser, docling, pymupdf, docx parsers.

nodes.label: get_openai_config (Legacy OpenAI/Azure Config)
nodes.rationale: Legacy config surface for OpenAI/Azure-only; bit-for-bit unchanged since v0.3.21; uses AZURE_API_KEY/ENDPOINT or OPENAI_API_KEY env vars.

nodes.label: get_llm_config (Multi-Provider Config)
nodes.rationale: Multi-provider surface available since gaik>=0.3.21; supports OpenAI, Azure, Anthropic, Google via ProviderClient with uniform chat/chat_parsed/chat_stream/embed interface.

nodes.label: Business Layer Workflow Templates
nodes.rationale: Extended BPMN-based workflow templates for GenAI use cases; makes business logic explicit for humans and machines (similar to n8n templates).

nodes.label: Dell'Acqua 2023 (AI Productivity Study)
nodes.author: Dell'Acqua
nodes.rationale: Consultants using AI completed 12.2% more tasks and 25.1% more quickly.

nodes.label: Brynjolfsson 2025 (Customer Support AI Study)
nodes.author: Brynjolfsson
nodes.rationale: Customer-support agents demonstrated 15% productivity increase with generative AI assistance.

nodes.label: BCG Report 2024 (GenAI Value Realization)
nodes.author: de Bellefonds et al.
nodes.rationale: Only 26% of companies have advanced beyond proof-of-concept to generate value from GenAI.

nodes.label: MIT Report 2025 (GenAI ROI)
nodes.author: Challapally et al.
nodes.rationale: Despite $30-40B enterprise investment in GenAI, 95% of organizations get zero return.

nodes.label: Oldemeyer et al. 2024 (SME AI Challenges)
nodes.author: Oldemeyer et al.
nodes.rationale: Literature review identifying top 3 AI implementation challenges for SMEs in industrial sector: knowledge, costs, and low digitalization maturity.

nodes.label: Observability / UsageRecord
nodes.rationale: Uniform token-usage, duration, and cost tracking across all LLM calls regardless of provider (OpenAI/Azure/Anthropic/Google); from gaik.observability module.
